future_possibility: Make reliable maintenance decisions without expensive onsite diagnostics for every ambiguity
strongest_complete_alternative: Current specialist inspection plus competent existing remote-diagnostic tools
current_constraint: Unobserved causal differences between sensor faults and equipment faults
missing_means: A validated minimum-cost discriminating measurement and intervention instrument
donor_mechanism: Active experimental design and fault-isolation from other physical systems
analogy_limit: Identifiability, sensor accuracy and site-specific physics may break the transfer
second_order_effect: Cheaper diagnoses could shift the limiting cost to safe intervention and warranty
decisive_experiment: Acquire rights-cleared paired fault cases and compare intervention choices with a competent technician protocol
falsifier: An ordinary calibrated diagnostic strategy matches complete performance at lower cost
economic_cohort: Undefined; requires a prospectively specified operating cohort
successor_family: Further sensor-minimizing investigation tools for industrial processes

beneficiary: Operators considering reuse of retired battery modules
future_possibility: Make safe reuse of currently discarded modules economically viable for a defined application
strongest_complete_alternative: New storage, whole-pack reuse, current diagnostics and certified recycling
current_constraint: Screening, uncertainty about remaining life, integration and warranty costs
missing_means: A reliable joint selection-and-life-estimation test protocol with decision guarantees
donor_mechanism: Reliability survival analysis and condition-based maintenance in aircraft fleets
analogy_limit: Battery chemistry and abuse history may invalidate the source-domain hazard model
second_order_effect: Successful screening could shift the constraint to traceability and liability allocation
decisive_experiment: Compare complete source-bound lifetime cost intervals of all strongest alternatives for an admitted cohort
falsifier: Existing whole-pack reuse or new storage remains cheaper after screening and liability costs
economic_cohort: Undefined; no measured module health, prices, warranties or actual buyer demand
successor_family: Other reusable-asset underwriting and validation instruments

beneficiary: Engineering organizations adopting automatically generated technical specifications
future_possibility: Make reliable high-volume specification generation affordable without proportionally expanding expert review
strongest_complete_alternative: Competent engineers with established requirements-management and formal checking tools
current_constraint: Critical omission and contradictory assumptions can survive fluent generation
